mapper.select: SELECT TOP_REGION_NAME topRegionName , LATITUDE latitude , LONGITUDE longitude FROM CL_REGION_COORD
SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM REGION_ENERGY_USAGE WHERE YEAR = #{year} AND MONTH = #{month}

SELECT TOP_REGION_NAME topRegionName, AVG_USE_QNT avgUseQnt, USAGE_PERCENT usagePercent, LATITUDE latitude, LONGITUDE longitude, REGION_KEY key, YEAR year, MONTH month FROM REGION_ENERGY_USAGE WHERE (YEAR, MONTH) = ( SELECT YEAR, MONTH FROM REGION_ENERGY_USAGE ORDER BY TO_NUMBER(YEAR) DESC, TO_NUMBER(MONTH) DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY ) ORDER BY TOP_REGION_NAME
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO REGION_ENERGY_USAGE ( ID, TOP_REGION_NAME, AVG_USE_QNT, USAGE_PERCENT, LATITUDE, LONGITUDE, REGION_KEY, YEAR, MONTH, UPDATED_AT ) VALUES ( REGION_ENERGY_USAGE_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{topRegionName}, #{avgUseQnt}, #{usagePercent}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{key}, #{year}, #{month}, SYSTIMESTAMP )
